provenance.paper_title: DriveWAM: Video Generative Priors Enable Scalable World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving

representation_paths.memory_component: bounded modality-aware KV memory pools for video latent tokens and action tokens carried across autoregressive chunks

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Selective KV Memory; Sec. 4.2 implementation
evidence.paraphrase: Video and action key/value tensors from the diffusion transformer are kept in two separate bounded pools (video budget 448 tokens, action budget 160 tokens) that persist across chunks of a long driving rollout. They are read back by ordinary self-attention when the next chunk is generated. Only KV tensors of VAE-encoded latents are retained; original frames are not recoverable from the pool.

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Selective KV Memory
evidence.paraphrase: After each generated chunk the memory pool is rewritten as H^{k+1}_m <- TopB(H^k_m) union deltaH^{k+1}_m, i.e. the new chunk's KV entries are appended to the persistent pool under a fixed rule during inference.

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Selective KV Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Cached tokens are scored by s_j = lambda * relevance (attention mass from current queries) - (1-lambda) * redundancy (cosine similarity to other cached keys), with lambda = 0.07; tokens below the retention budget are discarded at inference time. Figure 3 shows repeated road/sky/building tokens being evicted while moving vehicles and lane geometry are retained; Table 5 reports 3.07 GB -> 0.25 GB over a 300 s rollout.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (Sec. 3.3): the persistent KV memory pool changes during deployment through append plus relevance-redundancy eviction, but the retention rule and its hyperparameter (lambda = 0.07) are fixed and training-free, so no memory policy evolves from deployment feedback. All model learning (flow-matching objective, Eq. 4) is offline and was not counted as T3.

The curated PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles subset (Sec. 4.1, Appendix A: 100k train / 1k test clips) is a data curation of an existing dataset for driving-policy evaluation, not a memory benchmark, so no benchmark record was created.
